reason: The frozen original surface already gives the complete teardown race: Subscribe binds Handler::OnImage to raw this; Handler objects are destroyed before the transport node; ignition-transport copies callback handlers then invokes them after releasing its mutex, so Node destruction/Unsubscribe does not wait for an already-running callback; an in-flight frame therefore calls OnImage on a destroyed Handler. The issue also supplies a mutex-protected closed-flag repair, quantitative 31/100 -> 0/100 reproducer evidence, and a downstream workaround. The observed failure is SIGSEGV during shutdown, also outside the primary silent-semantic-correctness protocol.
